Advertisement for Engagement of Project Staff
Ar
Dean (Projects)
CSJMU, Kanpur
NAAC
(Under UP CoE, UP R&D, and CV Raman Research Grant, CSJMUSchemes)
Date: 20-04-2026
Applications are invited from eligible and interested candidates for engagement as Project Staff under
various research projects sanctioned under the Centre of Excellence (CoE), Utar Pradesh Research &
Development (UPR&D) Scheme, and CV Raman Research Grant Scheme at CSJMU, Kanpur.
No TA/DA shall be admissible for attending the interview.
The engagements are purely temporary and co-terminus with the respective projects. Details regarding the
number of positions, eligibility criteria, emoluments, and schedule of walk-in interviews are provided in
the respective advertisements attached herewith.
Interested candidates are advised to carefully go through the detailed advertisement and attend the walk-in
interview as per the specified date, time, and venue along with all required documents. Contact can be made
to the respective project investigator(s) by the email for any queries.
